thread:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a preemptive shard-fence before the console migration tonight (change window 23:00-01:00 UTC). Need quick agreement on pins + rollback criteria.

Sam: +1. Which services need pinned versions? API, runtime, router, console?

Maya: Yes. Primary risk is router schema handshake + runtime kernel switch. Proposing: pin API to v2.14.1, runtime to r-2026.03.10, router to rt-7f2, console to c-mig-3.

Leo: Runtime: r-2026.03.10 includes the batching kernel change. We should keep a conservative quantization profile on that pool during migration (qprof v3). If performance regresses, immediate rollback to r-2026.02.28.

Kevin: Router: rt-7f2 requires a small schema bump (route header v2). Will be backward compatible for 99% of traffic but older pinned nodes might reject. Recommend a staged traffic shift with 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m per step, and an automatic revert on 5xx > 1% for 10m.

Jia: Console: the migration adds a DB migration that can be rolled back only by restoring a snapshot. We must ensure snapshot is taken pre-migration and retention is >= 7 days. Ops, can you confirm snapshot plan?

ops-bot: Snapshot job queued: db-snapshots/console/2026-03-20T22:45Z. Estimated size 48GB. Will notify when complete.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan created:
```
# deploy plan
services: [api, runtime, router, console]
order: [api -> runtime -> router -> console]
pins: {api: v2.14.1, runtime: r-2026.03.10, router: rt-7f2, console: c-mig-3}
canary: {router: 10%/20m, runtime: 15%/15m}
rollback_on: {5xx_rate: 1%, p95_latency_increase: 30%}
```

Maya: Thanks deploy-bot. Ops: confirm snapshot done and that we have a tested restore runbook.

Sam: If runtime latency spikes due to kernel, we should be able to toggle batching aggressiveness per pool. I added a toggle in the runtime feature flags: `runtime.batch.tune=conservative`. That should be ready to flip from console.

Leo: Also adding a KV-cache warming step for common prefixes after deploy. Script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --model catalog`. Low risk, helps cold-start latency.

Kevin: Router stake: ensure healthcheck endpoint includes handshake logs for 30s after upgrade for quick triage. If handshake fails, route entirely to previous router cluster (pin fallback rt-6z9).

Jia: Ops confirmed snapshot complete. ops-bot: snapshot status?

ops-bot: Snapshot job completed at 2026-03-20T22:49Z. SHA: abc123. Restore runbook verified on staging.

Maya: Excellent. Rollback criteria (final proposed):
- Any service 5xx > 1% sustained for 10m -> immediate rollback of that service.
- p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline in 15m -> rollback.
- Console DB migration failure or restore time > 30m -> abort and restore snapshot.

Sam: Agree. Add emergency manual lock: `deploy-bot lock <release>` to cancel in-flight traffic shift.

Maya: one more thing — release notes snippet for customers: we need to call out potential short blips during migration and new router header handling. I'll draft and paste here.

Leo: Quick note for post-mortem checklist: collect runtime kernel perf profiles, router handshake logs, and KV cache hit rates for 24h.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for API at 2026-03-20T23:05Z (10% traffic). Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/d/rollouts/3202468000

Maya: I'll watch metrics for the first 20m. Please ping here for any anomalies. :eyes:

Kevin: Router canary healthy at 10% for 20m. No 5xx, p95 +4%. Proceed to 50%.

deploy-bot: Router shifted to 50% at 2026-03-20T23:35Z.

Jia: Console migration starting at 23:50 UTC. Snapshot restore checklist at hand.

ops-bot: Console migration DB started. ETA 8m.

Maya: If DB apply fails, execute restore and announce rollback.

ops-bot: DB apply completed successfully at 23:58 UTC.

Sam: Runtime kernel toggled to conservative batch profile at 23:59 UTC as precaution.

deploy-bot: Full traffic cutover to new router at 00:10 UTC. All services on pinned versions.

Leo: KV cache warmed. Observability shows p95 back to baseline.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll post release notes and mark the deployment as complete. Post-deploy checklist: keep enhanced tracing on for 24h and capture kernel profiles.

Kevin: Filing a small follow-up task to rotate router keys and remove fallback pins in 48h.

Maya: Closing here — no rollback needed. Great job. :tada:
